tasks.title: sim: scenario generator v0 emitting valid scenario files
tasks.goal: A seeded kitchen simulator (bins with profiles, plating spot, wash, pass, 1-3 cooks, tools, tickets) that runs simple prep workflows in a simulated world and writes scenario files whose expected answers come from that world, not from any propagation engine.
acceptance: uv run python -m sim.generate --seed 7 --count 5 --out data/scenarios/ writes 5 files that validate against scenario.schema.json: test_generated_valid
The same (generator version, seed) produces byte-identical files: test_deterministic
Ground truth comes from sampled true transfers and washes in sim.world; expected.decision is hold iff a forbidden unit truly reached the plate: test_truth_from_world
Every generated scenario carries tags generated and, when every true transfer was emitted, observation-complete: test_tags
No import from the provenance package anywhere in components/sim: test_no_provenance_import
README documents the v0 world model and CLI
out_of_scope: Error injection beyond a single happy-path workflow (sim-06)

tasks.title: sim: ADR for ground-truth and observation model
tasks.goal: Decide and document how the simulated world moves allergens and how observations are derived from it, so sim's answers stay independent of provenance.
acceptance: Team ADR PR to docs/adr/ (Director merges) covering per-action true transfer rates, wash efficacy, observation noise on probability, dropped edges, track loss -> late_entities
Defines hard vs soft expectations: for generated scenarios an expected hold is a hard requirement, an expected pass is a target; only observation-complete scenarios gate CI
Flags the gap that scenario.schema.json expresses these semantics only via tags, and proposes an RFC if a field is needed

tasks.title: sim: M0 corpus of >= 20 scenarios and CI subset
tasks.goal: Produce the M0 exit corpus covering the basic shapes every consumer needs.
acceptance: >= 20 generated scenarios covering basic transfer, wash reset, time order, multi-cook, shared utensil and a ticket with two constraints, listed in a manifest with sha256: test_manifest_matches
A CI subset <= 200 KB committed under components/sim/tests/fixtures/scenarios/; the full set regenerates from seeds: uv run python -m sim.generate --manifest components/sim/corpus-m0.json
Every file passes the same checks as tools/validate_contracts.py (schema, unique event IDs, bindings, chain references): test_corpus_valid

tasks.title: sim: propose three edge-case golden scenarios
tasks.goal: Hand-write golden scenarios for edges the first five don't cover, as a contract-change PR the Director merges.
acceptance: Three new files in contracts/scenarios/ for equal or overlapping timestamps, two-hop transfer via a hand, and a double wash; each description explains why the expected decision holds for any k in (0, 1]
python3 tools/validate_contracts.py passes
PR labeled contract-change and linked from a type:rfc issue with provenance and platform ACKs

tasks.title: sim: export scenarios as event and entity JSONL
tasks.goal: Turn any scenario into the replay streams other teams consume: interaction_event JSONL and an entity timeline JSONL.
acceptance: uv run python -m sim.export --scenario <file> --out <dir> writes events.jsonl (one interaction_event per line, time-ordered) and entities.jsonl (one entity per line): test_export_valid
Every line validates against its schema: test_lines_valid
Round trip: scenario -> JSONL -> scenario preserves events exactly: test_round_trip

tasks.title: sim: error-injection library
tasks.goal: Composable injectors for the mistakes and sensing failures that matter, each changing the simulated world or the observation model, never the expected answer directly.
acceptance: Injectors: skipped_wash, shared_utensil, bare_hand_contact, late_entity, track_loss (re-ID as a new entity listed in late_entities), amendment, dropped_edge, probability_noise; each unit-tested: uv run pytest components/sim -k inject
dropped_edge removes the observation-complete tag; the others keep it: test_tag_semantics
Injectors compose under one seed and stay deterministic: test_compose_deterministic

tasks.title: sim: 500-scenario corpus, CI subset and metrics script
tasks.goal: A large corpus outside git plus a committed observation-complete CI subset that provenance gates on, and a script that scores any verdict stream against it.
acceptance: >= 500 scenarios generated to data/ with data-manifest.json (name, size, sha256, generator version, seeds)
Committed CI subset <= 1 MB of observation-complete scenarios spanning every injector except dropped_edge
uv run python -m sim.metrics --scenarios <dir> --verdicts <verdicts.jsonl> prints false-pass count, false-hold rate and a per-tag breakdown: test_metrics_counts
out_of_scope: Running provenance (provenance owns its CI gate)

tasks.title: sim: Laya dataset generator v0 with leak-free splits
tasks.goal: Build (laya_request, target laya_response) pairs from simulated plate subgraphs, with ground-truth allergens and true chains, split so test data never leaks into training.
acceptance: uv run python -m sim.laya_data --corpus <dir> --out data/laya/ writes train/val/test JSONL; every request and response validates: test_pairs_valid
Splits by seed range AND held-out kitchen/recipe families; a test fails if any seed or scenario_id appears in two splits: test_no_leakage
Manifest with counts and sha256 per split
out_of_scope: Prompt or format design for a specific model

tasks.title: sim: model-agnostic Laya eval harness v0
tasks.goal: Evaluate any LayaClient on the test split, including the gate that Laya never misses an allergen ExactLaya finds; runs today with provenance's published ExactLaya and AdversarialLaya fakes.
acceptance: uv run python -m sim.laya_eval --client <import path> --split test writes report.json and report.md
Reports recall vs ExactLaya (gate: 100%), precision and recall vs ground truth, chain correctness, latency p50/p95, malformed rate: test_report_fields
Exits non-zero when the gate fails; AdversarialLaya flipped mode fails it, ExactLaya passes it: test_gate_behaviour
Uses ExactLaya only through the LayaClient interface (provenance's published fake)

tasks.title: sim: StateClient load generator
tasks.goal: Replay a long scenario through any StateClient at target rates and report throughput and latency, so state can verify its budget.
acceptance: uv run python -m sim.load --client <import path> --profile default drives upsert_entities at 5 Hz x 30 entities and record_interactions bursts up to 20/s
Reports p50/p95/p99 call latency and error counts as JSON
Runs against InMemoryStateClient in CI (short profile): test_load_inmemory

tasks.title: sim: long-shift stress scenario
tasks.goal: An 8-hour simulated shift with thousands of edges and many plates, kept outside git, for provenance's performance budget.
acceptance: uv run python -m sim.generate --profile long-shift --seed 1 produces a valid scenario with >= 5,000 events and >= 100 plates
Listed in data-manifest.json with sha256; regenerates byte-identically
Generation finishes in under 2 minutes on a laptop: reported in the PR
